title: Duodenal biopsy - narrative canned report v1 (Marsh-aware)

villous_architecture.description: Overall villous architecture. Map: 'normal/retained villi/retained villous architecture'->Retained; 'blunted/shortened villi/partial atrophy'->Blunted; 'subtotal villous atrophy'->Subtotal villous atrophy; 'total villous atrophy/flat mucosa'->Total villous atrophy.

iel_status.description: Intraepithelial lymphocytes. Map: 'no increase/within normal'->No increase; 'focal/focally increased IEL/patchy increased IEL'->Focally increased; 'increased/raised IEL'->Increased.

crypt_hyperplasia.description: Crypt hyperplasia. Map: 'crypt hyperplasia present'->Present; otherwise Not identified.

gastric_metaplasia.description: Gastric (foveolar) metaplasia. If text mentions 'gastric metaplasia' or 'foveolar metaplasia' set to Focal unless it explicitly says widespread/diffuse.

inflammation.description: Lamina propria inflammation/duodenitis. If text mentions 'inflammation' or 'duodenitis' without grade, set to Mild.

marsh_classification.description: If text explicitly states a Marsh grade, use it. Otherwise infer: Marsh 0=retained villi + no increase IEL. Marsh 1=increased IEL with retained villi. Marsh 2=Marsh 1 + crypt hyperplasia. Marsh 3a=blunted/partial villous atrophy + increased IEL + crypt hyperplasia. Marsh 3b=subtotal villous atrophy + increased IEL + crypt hyperplasia. Marsh 3c=total villous atrophy/flat + increased IEL + crypt hyperplasia. If villous architecture is Blunted (or worse) AND IELs are Increased/Focally increased, prefer Marsh 3a/3b/3c as appropriate rather than Marsh 1

comment_line.description: Optional extra line at end of conclusion.
